name: Attack
description: Lash out to deal direct harm or destruction.

name: Enhance
description: Temporarily boost senses, ability, or bestow something new.

name: Hinder
description: Impede or debilitate others or areas.

name: Protect
description: Defend yourself and others from outside harm or influence.

name: Restore
description: Heal wounds, cleanse maladies, and mend materials.

name: Reveal
description: Sense and reveal the hidden, and uncover new information.

name: Summon
description: Manifest objects, creatures, or forces themselves.

name: Transform
description: Change the nature or form of the subject.

name: Traverse
description: Move across space, through barriers, or in a new way.
